note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Bosnia and Herzegovina: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. Read again 2026-11-03: Republika Srpska's Labour Law as adopted (Sl. glasnik RS 1/16), from the National Assembly's own file, confirms its age of 15, the parents' written consent, the health finding, the bar on overtime (art. 64) and on night work, 19:00 to 06:00, for those under 18 (arts. 70 and 72, with temporary exceptions); the Federation's figures still rest on Paragraf.

figures.finding: Bosnia and Herzegovina's entities have no rule of their own for child performers: in the Federation no one under fifteen may be engaged in any kind of work, and a minor of fifteen to eighteen works with the legal representative's consent and a medical certificate, at most 35 hours a week, never overtime or at night; in Republika Srpska work starts at fifteen with the parents' written consent and a medical finding, no overtime, and night for minors runs 19:00-06:00.

sources.said: Sa licem mlađim od 15 godina života ne može se zaključiti ugovor o radu, niti se ono može zaposliti na bilo koju vrstu poslova. (2) Lice između 15 i 18 godina života (u daljem tekstu: maloljetnik) može zaključiti ugovor o radu, odnosno zaposliti se uz saglasnost zakonskog zastupnika
Puno radno vrijeme za maloljetne radnike ne smije biti duže od 35 sati sedmično.
Zabranjen je noćni rad maloljetnih radnika.
Radni odnos sa licem mlađim od 18 godina može da se zasnuje samo uz pismenu saglasnost roditelja, usvojioca ili staraoca
Za radnike mlađe od 18 godina noćnim radom smatra se rad između 19.00 časova i 06.00 časova narednog dana.
Члан 26. Радни однос може да се заснује са лицем које има најмање 15 година, одговарајућу здравствену способност
Радни однос са лицем млађим од 18 година може да се заснује само уз писмену сагласност родитеља, усвојиоца или стараоца, ако такав рад не угрожава његово здравље, морал и образовање
За раднике млађе од 18 година, ноћним радом сматра се рад између 19.00 часова и 06.00 часова наредног дана.
Радницима млађим од 18 година забрањен је ноћни рад.

figures.finding: In the Federation full capacity comes at eighteen or on earlier marriage; a minor's employment contract needs the legal representative's consent. No share of earnings is set aside by law.
